signals.title: Farm near Worcester (approx.): man, 24, found shot dead, 14 Oct
signals.content: Police say the body of a 24-year-old man with a gunshot wound to the head was found near a dam on a farm between Overhex, Worcester, and MaGwaleni, Zwelethemba, on the morning of Wednesday 14 October. Worcester police registered a murder case; spokesperson Lt-Col F.C. van Wyk said the motive is part of the investigation (Worcester Standard). One source only, and it does not say when he died.

signals.title: Epping, Cape Town (Fisher Ave, approx.): 2 men shot dead in taxi attack, 16 Oct
signals.content: SAPS says two men, aged 45 and 46, were shot dead on Fisher Avenue, Epping, on Friday 16 October at about 06:00, when men from a Toyota Quantum opened fire on their car. Police believe the motive is taxi-related. Two suspects, aged 27 and 31, were arrested on two counts of murder and were due in the Cape Town Magistrate's Court on 19 October (Cape Times). Accounts differ: a 17 October police statement called the dead men passengers and said the car's owner escaped (NovaNews); on 18 October police and Codeta called them taxi owners. Police gave the number of gunmen as about six, then seven.

signals.title: Belgravia, Athlone (approx.): woman, 65, and man shot dead, 10 Oct
signals.content: Police say a 65-year-old woman and an adult man were shot dead in Belgravia, Athlone, on Saturday 10 October at about 19:00; a third person was wounded and taken to hospital. Police spokesperson Wesley Twigg said the motive is believed to be gang-related (SABC News). No arrests had been made by 11 October (Cape Town ETC). Neither source gives a street.

signals.title: Cafda, Retreat (approx.): man, 30, and woman, 46, shot dead at home, 9 Oct
signals.content: SAPS says a 30-year-old man and a 46-year-old woman were shot dead at their home in Cafda, Retreat, on Friday 9 October at about 09:15, when gunmen chasing a rival gang member who ran onto the property missed him and hit them. Anti-Gang Unit detectives arrested a 32-year-old man on 14 October; he was due in the Wynberg Magistrates' Court on 16 October on two murder charges. Two men arrested after a chase on 9 October face firearm and stolen-property charges, not murder (Cape Argus). Reports name the street as Ensor or Enzo Street.

signals.title: Asla Park, Mossel Bay (Dunjwa St, approx.): man, 19, stabbed dead, 4 Oct
signals.content: Southern Cape police say officers found a 19-year-old with a stab wound to the chest at a scene in Dunjwa Street, Asla Park, Mossel Bay, on 4 October; paramedics declared him dead. Police allege he was hurt during an altercation with a group. No arrests had been made (Mossel Bay Advertiser, 13 October). One source only.
